en:
Miu was going to <CLT=cltSTRONG>meet up<CLT=cltNORMAL> with
someone in the Virtual World...

Mm-hm, with me! I was supposed to meet 
up with Miu on the roof of the mansion.
What? Is that true!?
I overheard them talking about it at the chapel.

By the way, *Miu* asked to meet up with me
before we went into the Virtual World...

I totally forgot where we were supposed to
meet, so good thing Kee-boy spied on us.
Wait, so Miu called Kokichi out?

If Miu brought the hammer... I wonder 
what she was planning to do with it?

<CLT=cltMIND>Kokichi's already figured it out.
She was planning to...
Kill Kokichi
Make Kokichi kill someone

She gave the hammer to Kokichi...
and asked him to kill for her...?

What are you saying? If you can't answer
correctly, then don't say anything useless.

<CLT=cltMIND>Everyone's staring at me... 
I screwed up, they think I'm a fraud... 
<CLT=cltNORMAL>
Plan a murder with Kokichi

Perhaps she was going to plot
a murder with Kokichi as a partner.

Any plan made by Miu would be boring, 
so that would be a no-go for me!

It'd totally be different if it was me though. I'd
plan out an awesome-and-not-boring crime!
Hey! Don't say things like that!

<CLT=cltMIND>Everyone's staring at me... 
I screwed up, they think I'm a fraud... 
<CLT=cltNORMAL>
Confess her love for Kokichi

She was going to confess her love for Kokichi...
and use the hammer if he turned her down...

Confessions on the rooftop or under a 
tree are stereotypical, but I admire them...

But, um...I think this situation 
may have been a bit different...

<CLT=cltMIND>Everyone's staring at me... 
I screwed up, they think I'm a fraud... 
<CLT=cltNORMAL>

No, seriously...what was she trying to do?
Shuichi, maybe you can tell me?

<CLT=cltMIND>Everyone's staring at me... 
I screwed up, they think I'm a fraud... 
<CLT=cltNORMAL>

<CLT=cltMIND>Miu asked to meet up with Kokichi
so she could use the hammer...
She was trying to kill Kokichi.
She was what!?

Yep. She plotted to meet up with me and
then kill me with the hammer...

If you want to prove this, you'll need
to figure out Miu's plan, okay?
<CLT=cltMIND>Miu's plan, huh?

<CLT=cltMIND>I'm sure if I analyze the clues we've
found, I can figure something out.
<CLT=cltMIND>Alright, let's do it!
